title: Viet Youth Resources
tagline: Greater Sacramento — high school and college

org.name: Community Partners Advocate of Little Saigon Sacramento

hero.headline: Find other clubs. Find cool things to do.
hero.body: For Vietnamese American students — and for VSAs and other Viet culture clubs. Who’s who nearby, events you can attend, perform at, or volunteer for — plus resources like scholarships.

chapters.headline: Who’s who
chapters.lead: VSAs and other Vietnamese clubs at schools nearby — plus a few campus performance teams. Follow them, go to a meeting, invite each other to culture nights.

bands.label: High school
bands.note: Vietnamese clubs in Elk Grove Unified (EGUSD) and Sacramento City Unified (SCUSD)

adjacent.name: Red Lotus
adjacent.note: Sac State dance / lion dance (campus performance team, next to the VSA)

adjacent.name: Blooming Lotus
adjacent.note: UC Davis lion dance team (like Red Lotus at Sac State)

events.headline: Events & projects
events.lead: One card per event. Inside each card: attend as a guest, perform or compete, and/or volunteer — whichever lanes are open. Closest next is listed first.

items.name: Camp Horizon
items.when: Fri–Sun Aug 14–16, 2026 · D.L. Bliss State Park (Tahoe)
items.about: A summer camping retreat for college VSA students — team activities and friends from other schools.

actions.detail: Fill out [Late registration form](https://forms.gle/NdLE9EeMS9FXrHVQ9) — or ask your VSA

items.name: Little Saigon Krewe @ Golden Harvest
items.about: Sacramento’s big fall parade — Vietnamese clubs and friends march together as one krewe (a parade crew).

actions.detail: Watch on Capitol Mall — bring family — krewe.cpalss.com
Register your club, dance team, or lion crew to march in the krewe block — krewe.cpalss.com or krewe@cpalss.com
Help set up or run the krewe block the morning of the parade — krewe@cpalss.com

items.name: Elk Grove Toy Drive
items.when: Sun Dec 6, 2026 · 3:30–7:30 PM (date may shift) · District 56 · 10th year
items.about: A free night for families — Santa, dinner, crafts, and shows. Unwrapped toys go to kids who need them.

actions.detail: Come as a guest — free — elkgrovetoydrive.com
Volunteer the day of or help plan earlier — contact@elkgrovetoydrive.com

items.name: VISTA Summit @ UC Davis
items.about: A high school summit on the UC Davis campus — workshops and college path stuff for Vietnamese American students. Run by UC Davis VSA (with partners on campus).

actions.detail: Follow @vista.vsaatucd for signup links and webinar dates

items.name: Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết
items.when: Sat–Sun Feb 13–14, 2027 · Elk Grove Park · free
items.about: A free Tết weekend — carnival rides, lion dance, kids stuff, and music. Great place to hang with family and friends.

actions.detail: Come both days — free — eglny.com
Youth Culture Day — culture clubs (advisor OK required) for dance or culture sets. Ask an officer + your advisor — eglny.com or contact@eglny.com
actions.subject: Youth Culture Day

actions.detail: Help run the festival — setup, directing guests, staffing a zone — contact@eglny.com
actions.subject: Lunar New Year Tết volunteer

items.name: NorCal UVSA Summit
items.when: Usually November (3 days / 2 nights on a member campus)
items.about: A weekend leadership conference for college VSAs — workshops, bonding, and service. Member schools take turns hosting.

actions.detail: Register when signup opens — norcaluvsa.org/summit or ask your VSA board

items.name: Miss & Miss Teen Vietnam Northern California
items.org: Miss & Miss Teen Vietnam Northern California
items.when: Usually January (next date TBA — watch Instagram)
items.about: A pageant and leadership program for young Vietnamese American women. Watch the show, compete, or help behind the scenes.

actions.detail: Watch for pageant night and appearance posts — @missvietnamnorcal

actions.label: Compete or Invite the Court
actions.detail: DM @missvietnamnorcal
DM @missvietnamnorcal

items.name: Florin Vietnamese Culture Night
items.about: Florin’s culture show. Expect next is a guess — follow Instagram for tickets and the real date.

actions.detail: Buy tickets when they post — @florinvsa
Guest-perform if they invite other schools — ask your officers to reach out

items.name: UC Davis VSA Culture Show
items.about: UC Davis VSA’s annual culture show. Expect next is a guess — follow @ucdvsacultureshow for tickets.

actions.detail: Watch for ticket posts — @ucdvsacultureshow
Guest-perform if invited — ask your officers

items.name: Sheldon Vietnamese Culture Night
items.about: Sheldon’s culture show. Expect next is a guess — follow Instagram for tickets and the real date.

actions.detail: Buy tickets when they post — @sheldonvsa
Guest-perform if they invite other schools — ask your officers to reach out

items.name: Monterey Trail Vietnamese Culture Night
items.about: Monterey Trail’s culture show. Expect next is a guess — follow Instagram for tickets and the real date.

actions.detail: Buy tickets when they post — @mthsvsa
Guest-perform if they invite other schools — ask your officers to reach out

items.name: VISION @ UC Berkeley
items.when: Usually mid-April (4 days / 3 nights on the Berkeley campus)
items.about: All-expense-paid high school leadership and identity intensive run by Cal VSA. Open to grades 9–12 (not Vietnamese-only). Berkeley is about 1½ hours from Greater Sacramento — doable if a parent can handle the trip when apps open.

actions.detail: Follow Cal VSA / [VISION](https://vsa.studentorg.berkeley.edu/vision/) for the application window

items.name: Cal VSA Culture Show
items.when: Usually mid-April (Berkeley — often Zellerbach or similar)
items.about: Cal VSA’s big annual theatrical culture show — singing, dance, drama. Out-of-region for Greater Sacramento (about 1½ hours), same idea as traveling to Summit: worth the trip if you can make it.

actions.detail: Watch for tickets on [Cal VSA Culture Show](https://vsa.studentorg.berkeley.edu/culture-show/) when the season posts
Cast/crew apps open on Cal VSA’s cycle (mainly Berkeley students) — see the Culture Show page for CORE / performance calls

resources.headline: Resources
resources.lead: Scholarships and other support that help your school path.

items.name: Vietnamese American Scholastic Achievement Awards
items.when: Application window each school year — check tuaiconnect.com
items.about: Scholarships and special awards for Vietnamese American students. Browse the site for which awards are open.

actions.detail: Apply on tuaiconnect.com when the form is open (ask a teacher or counselor if you need help)

coming.headline: More coming
coming.body: We’ll add more here — like Lạc Hồng (Vietnamese language school on weekends) and other groups students care about. Check back later in the year.

contact.headline: Questions?
contact.body: Something wrong, missing, or confusing? Email us. Dates can change — your club Instagram and these event sites are the place to double-check.
